title: Fixed Half-Open Gateleg Dining Table
description: One original static gateleg-style dining table shown in a single fixed half-open pose: a narrow central top, one curved D-shaped leaf held horizontally over a complete open U gateleg, and a second curved D leaf dropped vertically. Two full portal frames and three cross/root rails support the narrow centre; four small solid metal straps visibly connect the leaves. Thirteen closed editable meshes and three opaque constant matte PBR materials. All profiles and coordinates are newly authored, not a prior laundry table rotated, resized, deprived of slots or divided into new asset counts. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes or extra poses. Static furniture appearance only: no functioning hinge, folding rig, continuous motion clearance, mechanical operation, ergonomic fit, load, stability, installation or safety certification. Fixed curved leaf and gateleg structures deepen the original dining-table family without claiming a working expansion mechanism.
